correctness.rationale: For precisely b=3c/2, gamma=1+k>1, 0<alpha*c=lambda<2, direct substitution into source Eq. (2) gives F(x)=x(1-x)[x^k+(1-x)^k][lambda*z/2-tanh(k*artanh(z))], z=1-2x. The displayed first/second derivatives yield strict monotonicity of H_k(z)/z, with limits k and 1, so the iff equation has exactly two noncentral interior roots for 0<k<1, 2k<lambda<2, none otherwise. Sign alternation proves precise basins; cubic at equality proves nonhyperbolic repulsion. The standalone SymPy script was executed successfully, reproducing the complete exact cubic and slopes -4/9, 2sqrt(5)/75, -sqrt(2)/36. Finite qualitative samples are not relied on for the global theorem. The model assumptions and restrictions are explicit.

Indexed published-finding corpus queries returned differing dynamical systems and no dominating theorem. Residual publisher supplement/unindexed-literature risks are stated and not mistaken for novelty proofs.
residual_risks: The separate publisher-hosted PNAS supplemental PDF was not directly inspected; the accessible arXiv HTML includes its own appended supplementary S1–S3. An uninspected published addendum could affect novelty assessment.
Other unindexed specialized bifurcation analyses of complex-contagion games could imply the same theorem; negative searches do not certify priority.

The original Table 1 label “unstable & potentially non-unique” may assert only the existence of an unstable interior root, not instability of every interior root. The result is framed as a new complete phase classification rather than an unequivocal published-error correction.

value.rationale: The same source studies Snowdrift cooperation and labels an open parameter cell with stable pure states and potentially nonunique unstable interior equilibria. The new natural symmetry b/c=3/2 maintains the classical mixed point at 1/2 while exposing a sharp stable-coexistence island among two stable pure strategies. An exact complete three-attractor phase and full basin partition materially clarify evolutionary path-dependence and refine the source table; the universal if-and-only-if transition and hyperbolic witness are more than routine parameter substitution.
